name: Look to an Old Friend
summary: Master Mathias Shaw sends you to find an unusual ally in Stormwind's Trade District. Noble corruption shields traitors from ordinary justice, so Shaw turns to the city's finest cheesemonger and his intelligence network.

sections.title: Above the Law
sections.body:
Lord Gregor Lescovar and Marzon the Silent Blade have ties to the Defias Brotherhood, but Master Mathias Shaw has reached a dead end. Edwin VanCleef lies dead in the Deadmines, and Bazil Thredd has been eliminated in the Stockade. No living bandit leaders remain to testify.

Lescovar's noble rank and political ties keep him beyond ordinary Royal Guard justice and formal SI:7 warrants.

sections.title: The Cheesemonger's Ear
sections.body:
Master Mathias Shaw sends you to Elling Trias, owner of Trias' Cheese in the Trade District. Across Stormwind, Trias is known as a temperamental merchant who sells imported wedges and wheels. He also commands an independent network of eyes and ears that rivals SI:7.

Shaw hates turning to his former colleague. Yet exposing treason inside Stormwind Keep calls for methods beyond official royal channels.

faq.q: Why does Mathias Shaw send you to a cheese merchant?
faq.answer: Elling Trias is more than a cheesemonger. He runs Trias' Cheese near the Trade District entrance and keeps a far-reaching intelligence network. Shaw hates asking for his help, but SI:7 needs unusual means to act against a nobleman beyond ordinary law enforcement.

faq.q: Why can't Mathias Shaw simply arrest Lord Lescovar?
faq.answer: Lord Lescovar is a high-ranking Stormwind noble with deep ties across the House of Nobles. Shaw lacks the testimony to make the evidence hold against an aristocrat.

faq.q: Who is Marzon the Silent Blade?
faq.answer: Marzon the Silent Blade is a lethal operative working closely with the Defias conspiracy. He secretly communicates with Lord Lescovar inside Stormwind's court.

faq.q: Why does Trias mention Deathwing when you speak to him?
faq.answer: When Trias hears of the Defias Brotherhood conspiracy, he answers with bitter sarcasm. He scoffs that next you will tell him the long-lost Black Dragon Aspect Deathwing is alive and attacking the kingdom.

faq.q: What happens after meeting with Elling Trias?
aliases: where to after look to an old friend
faq.answer: After hearing the full account of the conspiracy, Trias begins planning a quiet infiltration of Stormwind Keep. He means to corner Lord Lescovar without alerting the rest of the noble court.
Elling Trias is inside Trias' Cheese in Stormwind's Trade District, just off the main road from the city gates.

angles.text: As a rogue, you can see the uneasy rivalry between Mathias Shaw and Elling Trias. Street-level informants can hold more influence than the crown's official intelligence division.
As an Alliance member, you see how corruption in the House of Nobles hampers Stormwind's internal security while King Varian Wrynn remains missing.
